$comment: Written by agentic-cms schema from the collection's zod schema; do not edit by hand.

title.description: The H1 and card title, the <title> unless seoTitle is set, and the JSON-LD headline

excerpt.description: Card text, meta description fallback, RSS and JSON-LD description; 30–40 reader-focused words; required unless seoDescription is set

date.description:
The editorial date readers see, YYYY-MM-DD (quote it); the primary sort key, newest first
A date, YYYY-MM-DD, quoted in YAML.

category.description:
The eyebrow label and articleSection, also the related-post fallback
A slug of content/categories.json; agentic-cms check checks it.

author.description:
The byline, the author card and the JSON-LD author
A slug of content/authors.json; agentic-cms check checks it.

image.description: Hero image on the post page and the JSON-LD image, under public/images/blog/<slug>/

imageAlt.description: What the hero image shows, in a sentence

ogImage.description: Open Graph / Twitter image, about 1.91:1 and at least 1200 px wide; defaults to image, then thumbnail

seoTitle.description: The exact <title> and og:title, 60 characters or fewer; defaults to the title followed by " | " and the site's name

seoDescription.description: Meta description, 70–160 characters; defaults to excerpt

related.description: Slugs shown first under "Read next", topped up by same category, then newest; every slug must exist, drafts included

items.description: A slug of content/blog/ (a file's name without its extension); agentic-cms check checks it.

source.description: Provenance note, e.g. the URL an imported post came from

publishedAt.description: ISO timestamp for JSON-LD datePublished, the RSS pubDate and the sitemap; set once when the post first goes live

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp for JSON-LD dateModified; add it only after editing a published post (a value before publishedAt is clamped by posts.ts)

draft.description: true keeps the post out of production builds; pnpm dev still renders it

description: content/blog: A post's frontmatter: content/blog/<slug>.md, where the filename is the URL /blog-post/<slug> (a post's frontmatter, one file per entry, the file name is the slug).
